apo_customForms_metadata.description: Contains metadata description of a custom form, including the custom fields metadata.

name.description: The name of the custom form

description.description: Describes the usage or puporse of the custom form.

id.description: The unique string identifier of the custom form.

customFormType.description: Indicates whether the custom form is for an address, parcel, or owner.

apo_customForms_metadata_fields.description:
Describes the metadata of a custom field. 

Added in Civic Platform version: 9.2.0

id.description: The unique custom field id.

description.description: Describes the usage or purpose of the custom field.

dataType.description: The field data type. If the custom field is a DropdownList, the options[] array contains the list of possible values, or the sharedDropdownListName specifies the name of a shared dropdown list containing the possible values.

defaultValue.description: Any default value for the custom field.

displayOrder.description: The display order of the field on the custom form.

unit.description: The unit of measure of a numeric custom field.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether or not the field is required.

isPublicVisible.description: Indicates whether or not a citizen user can see this field.

isRecordSearchable.description: Indicates whether or not the field is searchable.

options.description: Contains possible field values, if the field is a dropdown field type.

sharedDropdownListName.description: The name of the shared dropdown list, if the field is a dropdown field type.

customFormMetadataModel.description: Contains the metadata for a custom form.

id.description: The custom form id.

customTableMetadataModel.description: Contains the metadata for a custom table.

id.description: The custom table id.

isReadonly.description: Indicates whether or not the custom field is read-only.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether or not the custom field is required.

gisIDForAssetID.description: The name of the GIS ID field that is mapped to the asset ID.

gisService.description: The GIS service to be used with the asset. The GIS service should be a configured map service in Accela GIS Administration.

group.description: The name of the asset group. For example: Water or Street. An Asset Group is an agency-defined collection of objects the agency owns or maintains.

id.description: The id of the asset type.

type.description: The type of asset. For example: Hydrant or Manhole. An Asset Type is an agencydefined classification of similar objects that share the same standard asset attributes. Related asset types belong to an asset group, and multiple asset types can share the same Class Type.

group.description: The name of the asset group. For example: Water or Street. An Asset Group is an agency-defined collection of objects the agency owns or maintains.

type.description: The type of asset. For example: Hydrant or Manhole. An Asset Type is an agencydefined classification of similar objects that share the same standard asset attributes. Related asset types belong to an asset group, and multiple asset types can share the same Class Type.

addressTypeGroup.description: The name of the address type group that contains permissible address tyeps for instances of the record type.

customFormGroup.description: The name of the custom forms group for instances of the record type.

documentCode.description: The code that defines the document types for the record type.

expirationCode.description: The code that defines the parameters for expiring records that are instances of the record type.

feeSchedule.description: The name of the fee schedule associated with instances of the record type.

inspectionGroup.description: The name of the inspection group that contains the inspection-related parameters applied to instances of the record type.

recordStatusGroup.description: The group of record statuses associated with the record type.

items.description: The name of the standard comment group associated with instances of the record type.

virtualFolderGroup.description: The name of the virtual folder group associated with instances of the record type.

workflow.description: The name of the workflow associated with instances of the record type.

category.description: The 4th level in a 4-level record type structure (Group-Type-Subtype-Category).

readable.description: Indicates whether or not values for sibling fields are readable.

description.description: The condition assessment description. If the description is null, this field is not returned.

bureau.description: The name of the bureau, which is an organization level within an agency.

division.description: The name of the division, which is an organization level within a bureau.

id.description: The department system id assigned by the Civic Platform server.

office.description: An organization level within a group. An office is the final level within an organization structure. Agency->Bureau->Division->Section->Group->Office.

section.description: A piece of a township measuring 640 acres, one square mile, numbered with reference to the base line and meridian line.

gISLayerIdModel.description: The GIS layer in the GIS service to be used with the asset. The GIS layer should be a configured map layer on the GIS service in Accela GIS Administration.

display.description: The display name of the GIS layer ID.

required.description: Indicates whether or not it is required for an address type.

grade.description: The name of the inspection grade.

gradeImage.description: The link to an image file associated to the inspection grade.

group.description: The inspection grade group for the inspection grade value.

maximumMajorViolation.description: Used with the maxMajorViolation field to define a range of the acceptable number of major violations for an inspection.

maximumScore.description: Used with the minScore field to define a range of acceptable values for an inspection.

minimumMajorViolation.description: Used with the maxMajorViolation field to define a range of the acceptable number of major violations for an inspection.

minimumScore.description: Used with the maxScore field to define a range of acceptable values for an inspection.

allowFailChecklistItems.description: Indicates whether or not to allow inspection to pass with failed checklist items for the current inspection type or from previous inspections.

allowMultiInspections.description: Indicates whether or not to allow the scheduling of multiple inspections for this inspection type.

carryoverFlag.description:
Indicates how failed guidesheet items for an inspection type are carried over to the next inspection guidesheet. 

NULL or empty string : Guidesheet items are not carried over. 

"A" : Automatic carry-over of failed guidesheet items to the next inspection guidesheet item.

disciplines.description: The inspection disciplines assigned to the inspection type.

flowEnabledFlag.description: Indicates whether or not to include the inspection in the inspection flow process.

grade.description: The name of the inspection grade.

group.description: The name of a group of inspection types.

groupName.description: The descriptive name associated to an inspection group code.

hasCancelPermission.description: Indicates whether or not the user can reschedule the inspection.

hasFlowFlag.description: Indicates whether or not to include the inspection in the inspection flow process.

hasNextInspectionAdvance.description: Indicates whether or not the next inspection can be scheduled in advance.

hasReschdulePermission.description: Indicates whether or not the user can reschedule the inspection.

hasSchdulePermission.description: Indicates whether or not the user can schedule the inspection. Note that hasSchdulePermission returns "Y" if result.inspectionTypes.schdulePermission is either "REQUEST_ONLY_PENDING", "REQUEST_SAME_DAY_NEXT_DAY", or "SCHEDULE_USING_CALENDAR". If result.inspectionTypes.schdulePermission is "NONE" or null, hasSchdulePermission returns "N".

id.description: The inspection type system id assigned by the Civic Platform server.

inspectionEditable.description: Indicates whether or not inspection result, grade or checklist can be edited.

isAutoAssign.description: Indicates whether or not you want to automatically reschedule the inspection when the previous inspection status attains Approved status.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether or not the information is required.

maxPoints.description: The number of points allowed for an inspection, after which the inspection fails.

priority.description: The priority level assigned to the inspection type.

publicVisible.description: Indicates whether or not Accela Citizen Access users can view comment about the inspection results.

refereceNumber.description: The reference number associated with an inspection.

resultGroup.description: The name of a grouping of Inspection results, usually indicative of a range of inspection scores.

totalScore.description: The overall score of the inspection that includes the inspection result, inspection grade, checklist total score and checklist major violation option.

totalScoreOption.description:
Indicates the method for calculating total scores of checklist items. There are four options:  

TOTAL - Gets the total score of all checklists as the inspection score. 

MAX - Gets the max score of all checklists as the inspection score. 

MIN - Gets the min score of all checklists as the inspection score. 

AVG - Gets the average score of all checklists as the inspection score. 

SUBTRACT - Subtracts the total score of all the checklist items from the Total Score defined for the inspection type.

unitNumber.description: The number of time units (see timeUnitDuration) comprising an inspection.

units.description: The amount of time comprising the smallest time unit for conducting an inspection.

value.description: The value for the specified parameter.

standardCommentGroup.description: The name of the standard comment group associated with the inspection type.

inspectionBeforeScheduledTime.description: Specifies the number of days or hours before the scheduled time on the inspection date.

resultType.description: The type of result that can be ascibed to an inspection. There are three result types: Approved: Approves (passes) the checklist item. Denied: Denies (fails) the checklist item. Informational: Indicates that the checklist items do not need a status of app.
